findings.description: Specific, checkable claims extracted from sources actually read.

claim.description: One specific, checkable claim — not a topic, a claim that could be true or false.

sourceUrl.description: URL of the source the claim was actually read from.

sourceDate.description: Publication or last-updated date of the source if known (ISO-8601 or as printed).

quote.description: Short supporting quote from the source, verbatim.

confidence.description: How well the source supports the claim.

gaps.description: What this sub-question could not settle — unanswered angles or missing evidence.
